candidate_055.name: verified-provenance admission gate for durable scientific memory
candidate_055.mechanism_hypothesis: Do not promote generated scientific facts, citations, measurements or operational lessons into hard/institutional memory merely because they were repeatedly produced. Keep them soft/quarantined until a source-qualified external identity/topic/admissibility check passes; hard memory entries carry immutable provenance and can be revoked or downgraded when later verification contradicts them. Strategic hypotheses remain soft even after citation verification unless separately validated.

primary_evidence.source: VaaS is a Multi-Layer Hallucination Reduction Pipeline for AI-Assisted Science: Production Validation and Prospective Benchmarking, medRxiv 2026
primary_evidence.design: Prospective 40-gene benchmark with four Claude-arm conditions at four temperatures, n=160 runs per condition, plus 117 independent open-weight runs; total 757 runs.
primary_evidence.interpretation: Live external PMID/topic verification was the load-bearing gate. Corrections-only reduced errors but did not provide the same externally verified guarantee. This directly supports verifying scientific identity/topic support before admitting citation-like facts into durable trusted memory.
primary_evidence.limits: This is a biomedical citation-synthesis benchmark, not a long-horizon memory ablation. C2 correction-only error rates are AI self-reported rather than live-fetch measured, so they are not directly equivalent to C1/C3/C4 measurements.

primary_evidence.source: A Persistent Fleet of AI Scientists Exhibits Cooperative and Autopoietic Behavior, bioRxiv 2026
primary_evidence.interpretation: The fleet report links trusted provenance plus project memory to persistent scientific operation and improved internal institutional-knowledge performance, while independently reporting a strong identity-level fabrication constraint.
primary_evidence.limits: The project-memory 44% to ~90% result is an internal benchmark and the public abstract does not isolate memory admission/provenance as a matched causal component. Shared-fleet operation is descriptive and should not be generalized to independent clean exploration.

candidate_055.relation_to_candidate_054: Candidate 054 split memory by authority (hard operational contracts versus soft strategic lessons). Candidate 055 adds a prerequisite for hard promotion: externally verified, source-qualified provenance/admissibility. Repetition alone is not sufficient authority.
candidate_055.status: New mechanism hypothesis with direct verification-gate evidence for citation-like scientific facts and descriptive long-horizon fleet support; causal benefit for durable research memory itself remains untested.
candidate_055.falsifier: A matched multi-seed long-horizon research-agent study where provenance-verified admission into hard memory fails to reduce persistent factual/citation contamination or improve downstream held-out scientific reliability relative to unverified hard memory, after equalizing retrieval, context and compute.
